Name: (CP) Custom Farm Animal Names
Author: RunoV
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

Custom Farm Animal Names lets you change the names of any of the vanilla farm animal types (plus horses) via CFAN's config file.  This new name is reflected in all the UI text and special messages related to that animal, the names and descriptions of the goods the animal produces (optionally), and assorted dialogue, secret note, book, TV show, and mail text as well.  You can also change the shop icons for any of the animals sold by Marnie, though you will need to provide your own images.

This mod is intended to add immersion to animal reskin CP mods. I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt n Skin[/url] (check [url=https://smapi.io/mods]mod compatibility list[/url] for most recent unofficial update) or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2274]More Animals[/url] if you'd like to use different skins for the same type of animal.

Note that for now, dialogue is only changed where it refers to your own farm animals, not farm animals belonging to other people (if you change your chickens into phoenixes, you may get asked about the phoenixes on your farm, but Shane will still be into chickens.) A future update may provide the option to replace the animal name in all other dialogue as well.

[size=5][b]Config Options[/b][/size]

This mod has quite a lot of configuration options, and I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make changing them more manageable.

[b][size=4]Animal-specific config options:[/size][/b]

[b][font=Courier New][Animal]Name[/font][/b] (default: [font=Courier New]false[/font])

The new name you would like to use for this type of animal.  The first letter should be capitalized. A value of [font=Courier New]false[/font] means the animal will not be renamed.

[b][font=Courier New][Animal]NamePlural[/font][/b] (default: [font=Courier New]false[/font])

The plural form of the animal's name.  The first letter should be capitalized.  If you leave this [font=Courier New]false[/font] but enter something for [font=Courier New][Animal]Name[/font], the singular name will also be used as the plural.

[b][font=Courier New]Retain[Animal]NameCase[/font][/b] (Accepted values: [font=Courier New]true, false[/font]) (default: [font=Courier New]false[/font])

Set this to [font=Courier New]true[/font] if you would like the animal name to stay capitalized in contexts where it would normally be lowercase in your language (e.g. the middle of a sentence).

[b][font=Courier New][Animal]NameIsAdjective[/font][/b] (Accepted values: [font=Courier New]true, false[/font]) (default: [font=Courier New]false[/font])

Only brown, white, void, and golden chickens have this option. If set to true, [font=Courier New][Animal]Name[/font] is treated as an adjective modifying whatever you have set[font=Courier New] ChickenName[/font] to (or just modifying "chicken" if you didn't set a new chicken name). For example, if [font=Courier New]ChickenName[/font] is set to "Pheasant" and you want your void chickens to become Purple Pheasants producing Purple Eggs, set [font=Courier New]VoidChickenName[/font] to "Purple", and set [font=Courier New]VoidChickenNameIsAdjective[/font] to [font=Courier New]true[/font].  If you want your void chickens to be Purple Pheasants producing Purple Pheasant Eggs instead, set [font=Courier New]VoidChickenName[/font] to "Purple Pheasant" and set [font=Courier New]VoidChickenNameIsAdjective[/font] to [font=Courier New]false[/font].

[b][font=Courier New]Modify[Animal]Products[/font][/b] (Accepted values: [font=Courier New]true, false[/font]) (default: [font=Courier New]true[/font])

If [font=Courier New]true[/font], any eggs/milk/etc. produced by the animal will also be renamed, any mention of the animal in their descriptions will be replaced by the new name, and dialogue or other game text that mentions those products will be changed.

Additional Notes:

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ModifyCowProducts[/font], [font=Courier New]ModifyBrownChickenProducts[/font], and [font=Courier New]ModifyWhiteChickenProducts[/font] have accepted values of [font=Courier New]name[/font], [font=Courier New]description[/font], [font=Courier New]both[/font], and [font=Courier New]false[/font].  A value of [font=Courier New]name[/font] will mean only the item names are modified, a value of [font=Courier New]description[/font] means only the item descriptions are modified, and a value of [font=Courier New]both[/font] means that both the item names and descriptions will be modified.  (If you choose to modify the names of these items, the new animal name will be added even though the original animal name wasn't there; e.g., if you rename brown chickens to "Turkey", and set [font=Courier New]ModifyBrownChickenProducts[/font] to [font=Courier New]name[/font] or [font=Courier New]both[/font], brown Eggs and Large Eggs will become Turkey Eggs and Large Turkey Eggs.)
[*]Wool and basic Mayonnaise are not changed, as they are produced by multiple different animals.
[/list][size=4][b]
Additional config options:
[/b][/size]
[font=Courier New][b][Animal]IconFilename[/b]
[/font]
Type the name of a png file in the mod's[i]assets/icons[/i] folder to replace that animal's icon in Marnie's shop (or the horse icon in the inventory menu for [font=Courier New]HorseIconFilename[/font]).  Leave out the .png extension.  Shop icons should be 32px by 16px, and the horse icon should be 16px by 16px.  I included an icon from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6567]Belted Galloway[/url] mod as an example, but otherwise no icons are provided.  You will need to get them from retexture mods or make them yourself.

I edited the alpaca and deer icons in the example screenshot from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3167]Elle's New Barn Animals[/url] with permission, and the quail icon from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7046]Banties and Quails for Adopt n Skin[/url], which permits modification.  Many mod creators are fine with people editing their assets for personal use, as long as you don't distribute the edits, but make sure to check the mod permissions and ask if you aren't sure.

[b][font=Courier New]ModifyAnimalShop, ModifyBooks, ModifyBuildingDescriptions[/font], etc.[/b] (Accepted values: [font=Courier New]true, false[/font]) (default: [font=Courier New]true[/font])

Selectively disable certain types of game text replacement by setting these to [font=Courier New]false[/font]. If you find conflicts with other mods that edit the same text, you can disable CFAN's editing of that type of text.

[size=5][b]Mod Compatibility[/b][/size]

Content Patcher mods load in alphabetical order, so this mod will overwrite any changes made to the same pieces of text by CP mods earlier in the alphabet, and be overwritten by CP mods later in the alphabet.

CFAN has specific compatibility patches for the following mods:

[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]﻿ by cometkins[/b]
BAG edits the name and description of the Rabbit's Foot.  If you have Better Artisan Goods installed, CFAN will use the BAG name for the Rabbit's Foot and edit your rabbit replacement name into the BAG Rabbit's Foot item description.[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]﻿ by gizzymo[/b]
If you have CFDE installed, CFAN will replace animal names in CFDE dialogue as well as vanilla dialogue.  (The randomized festival dialogue after year 3 will not be edited.)[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7660]Ostrich Mayo & Golden Mayo[/url]﻿ by ughitsmegan[/b]
The Ostrich Mayonnaise and Golden Mayonnaise from this mod will be also be renamed if you rename the Ostrich and Golden Chicken and enable modifying their products.[/list][b][size=5]
Translation Notes[/size][/b]

Custom Farm Animal Names supports all languages available in the vanilla game, but it works better for some languages than others.  In languages with gendered nouns (e.g. Spanish, French, Portugese), you will see incorrectly gendered articles and adjectives if your new name has a different gender than the original.  In Korean, word-final particles that change depending on whether the base word ends with a vowel or a consonant will be incorrect if the new word would use a different version of the particle than the original.  In highly inflected languages (Hungarian, Turkish, Russian) where nouns have many different forms, CFAN's changes are not going to be grammatically correct, since it only has one singular form and one plural form to work with.  The Russian version is particularly bad.  

If you'd like to make the text more grammatically correct, you can directly edit the file for your language in CFAN's [b]i18n[/b] folder. Tokens are the things look like [b]{{this}}[/b], and they are replaced by the animal name you provided when the text is displayed in the game.  For example, in Russian, you could replace the tokens [b]{{PigName}}[/b], [b]{{PigNamePlu}}[/b] etc. with the correct form of your pig replacement name in [b]i18n/ru.json[/b].  Just keep in mind that if you later change the name of that animal again, you will need to directly edit ru.json again as well.

As a last note, I don't actually know very much of any of these languages! The text is all from the vanilla translations, but the specific pieces of text I replaced with replacement name tokens, and the minor edits I made in some places, may well have errors aside from the language-specific issues listed above.  I would greatly appreciate any corrections!
